verses.1: Praise the LORD, for His goodness lasts forever.
verses.2: Praise the God of God, for His kindness lasts forever.
verses.3: Praise the gods of the gods, for their grace lasts forever.
verses.4: To do great deeds alone, for His kindness lasts forever.
verses.5: To create the heavens in chaos, for His everlasting kindness.
verses.6: Over the land that lies on the waters, for ever shall His kindness be present.
verses.7: To create great lights, for ever is His grace.
verses.8: Let the sun shine on us in this day, for its grace lasts forever.
verses.9: The stars and the moon shine during the night, for His kindness lasts forever.
verses.10: To destroy the Egyptians in their graves, so that His kindness may last forever.
verses.11: And Israel was delivered from them, for His grace will last forever.
verses.12: With strong hands and a steady grip, for ever is His kindness.
verses.13: To make the Sea of Galilee a place of refuge, so that its grace may last forever.
verses.14: And Israel shall dwell in his midst forever, for His kindness lasts forever.
verses.15: And Pharaoh and his army were drowned in the sea, because of His eternal kindness.
verses.16: To lead his people across the sea, so that His grace may last forever.
verses.17: To be like the great kings, for ever to enjoy His grace.
verses.18: And great kings were killed, because of His everlasting kindness.
verses.19: To Sihon, king of the Amorites, may his mercy be forever.
verses.20: And to say to the king of the Baashaites, “May your kindness last forever!”
verses.21: And he gave their land as a blessing, so that His kindness would last forever.
verses.22: May the Lord bless Israel forever, for His kindness endures forever.
verses.23: In our humility, He reminded us that His grace lasts forever.
verses.24: And He freed us from our slavery, for His mercy lasts forever.
verses.25: He gives bread to all creatures, for His kindness lasts forever.
verses.26: Praise the God of heaven, for His kindness lasts forever.
